$comment: Negative ParticipationDescriptor cases. Each case names WHICH layer must reject it: schema (participation.schema.json) or semantic (state-transitions.md §4-§5 invariants enforced by validate.mjs). Base documents are minimized variants of train-window-w42.json; only the named delta matters.

cases.name: revision-as-json-number-unsafe-integer
cases.reason: uint64 must be a decimal string; a JSON number is rejected outright — 9007199254740993 (2^53+1) is already unsafe in JS Number.

cases.name: revision-uint64-overflow
cases.reason: 18446744073709551616 = 2^64 passes the 20-digit shape pattern but exceeds the uint64 bound; the runtime range layer rejects it (two-layer rule).

cases.name: opportunity-unknown-group-ref
cases.reason: o_decision.action_group_id references a group the descriptor does not declare.

cases.name: opportunity-beyond-window
cases.reason: expires_at after window.closes_at violates 'within the named current window'.

cases.name: opportunity-not-before-after-expiry
cases.reason: not_before must be strictly before expires_at.

cases.name: duplicate-dedupe-key
cases.reason: Two opportunities sharing one dedupe key would alias one consumption record.

cases.name: budget-window-mismatch
cases.reason: budget.window_id must be the current window id.

cases.name: unknown-resource-enum
cases.reason: resource must be one of the three named resources.

cases.name: unknown-extra-field
cases.reason: additionalProperties false — 'hint' (a disguised instruction field) must not sneak in.

cases.name: timestamp-with-offset
cases.reason: RFC 3339 must be UTC Z form; +00:00 is rejected so there is exactly one encoding per instant.

cases.name: channels-unknown-value
cases.reason: channels vocabulary is closed: intent | direct_message.

cases.name: declared-slot-key-mismatch
cases.reason: C2: the window declares dm_response_slot_key w_42/reply, but the DM-qualified opportunity o_reply carries a different dedupe key — every DM-qualified opportunity of a declared window must carry exactly the slot key.
